title: Same model, different harness
takeaway: The harness is part of the result; the same model can score differently in different systems, without a universal winner.

scenes.title: Hold the model still
scenes.visual: 0.1.1: pairedBars builds three independent model rows in a harness matrix, with gradeBadge A and reported confidence whiskers; model labels stay fixed while harness labels change. Show all conditions below the matrix, not behind an interaction. 0.1.2: highlight GPT-5's Codex CLI result, then the reversed vendor-harness ordering for Opus; never animate this as a universal winner. 0.1.3: dateStamp and a historical-study label remain visible. No product UI or logo recreation.

sentences.text: Peer-reviewed Terminal-Bench and SWE-agent studies show different scores from the same model with different harnesses.
sentences.spoken: Peer reviewed Terminal Bench and S W E agent studies show different scores from the same model with different harnesses.

scenes.title: An interface intervention
scenes.visual: 0.2.1: diagram fixes the GPT-4 Turbo core while an outer shell-only ring swaps to the SWE-agent interface; pairedBars shows only the Lite comparison. Keep the demonstration and budget conditions beside both bars; no additive waterfall or comparison with the preceding Terminal-Bench axis. 0.2.2: hold the fixed core and changed interface together for the takeaway.
